summary: Sprint 4.0-2 DCO developer tooling verified end-to-end via ?preview=writing&dco. Dev button appears on writing screen after session creation, panel opens, refresh after AI turn populates all 7 required developmental fields with estimate + confidence + evidence bullets, raw JSON view shows the complete object including confidence and evidence keys. Gating confirmed: button is absent without ?dco.
critical_code_review_comments: PublicPreview.jsx is ~1370 lines — flagged for future refactor per >700 LOC guideline (not blocking this sprint).
DevCognitionPanel initial 400ms setTimeout in useEffect fetches before any turn exists — that's fine; UI shows 'No developmental_cognition yet. Press ↻' as designed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route ?preview=writing&dco puts learner in student mode (StudentEntry -> WritingScreen). Session is created on student-assignment-continue click; dev button appears from that point. DCO fields render with 'coordinative_capacity: 2 evidence bullets' (Fischer terminology). AI turn ~40-90s. Raw JSON size ~4.7KB with confidence + evidence keys.
